title: Generic Sample Plating Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck and labware
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map: place a 2 mL tubeblock containing proteinase K (position A1) and internal control (position B1) on the temperature module in slot 1, and position a NEST 96‑deepwell plate (2 mL) in its designated slot.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (version 3.19.0 or later) and upload the protocol file.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑App, calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the single‑channel pipette as described in the support articles.

steps.title: Transfer samples to deepwell plate
steps.instruction: Using a single‑channel pipette, dispense each sample from the source tuberack into the NEST 96‑deepwell plate following column‑wise then row‑wise order: fill wells A1, B1, C1 … H1, then A2, B2, C2 … etc.

steps.title: Add proteinase K and internal control
steps.instruction: To each well containing a sample, add 10 µL of proteinase K from the tubeblock (A1) and then 10 µL of internal control from the tubeblock (B1).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑App to execute the protocol.
